Old Grand-Dad: grandson and 1882 (Beam, Wikipedia); Wathen family, American Medicinal Spirits and medicinal whiskey under Prohibition, National Distillers at the Frankfort plant (Wikipedia, a bourbon history site); Bonded Straight Bourbon Whiskey and the bond rule (Beam); 80, 100 and 114 proof bottlings and the yearly 7 Year Bonded (Beam, Wikipedia, trade press).

Basil Hayden: Basil Hayden Sr. died 1804, will proved August 1804, the 1785 settlement of Maryland Catholics on Pottinger's Creek (state marker, genealogy records); 80 proof and the 1992 collection (Beam, Wikipedia); the possessive dropped with the 2021 relaunch (design write-up, Toast launch coverage).
Bulleit: 1987, the 1830s tale, groundbreaking 2014 and opening March 2017 near Shelbyville (brand release, Wikipedia); 68, 28 and 4 widely given (Wikipedia, VinePair); 45% ABV (brand, Difford's).

Rabbit Hole: founded 2012 and its own distillery 2018 (Whisky Advocate, trade press); Pernod Ricard 2019 and Heigold launched weeks later in the rebrand (Whisky Advocate, The Manual); 70, 25 and 5, entry at 110 proof, toasted then charred, 95 proof (house); Cavehill 95 proof, four grains all malted beside the corn, Dareringer 93 proof in PX casks (house); Heigold a German stonecutter or stonemason who reached Louisville about 1850 and died in 1865 as the facade was finished (state marker, Atlas Obscura).

tension: The Library's Four Roses says single-storey rack warehouses produce far more consistent ageing, and its Behind the bar line speaks of best value: a superlative and a price word the house voice refuses.

The liquor shelf's Rabbit Hole Heigold calls Christian Heigold a stonemason who settled in Louisville before 1850 and dates the carving from 1857; the record says stonecutter (state marker) and gives no arrival year, since sources give about 1850.

The high-rye-bourbon style's quiz[2] explain says the founder named Old Grand-Dad for his grandfather in 1882; Beam's page and Wikipedia agree the namer was the grandson, a distiller, and this record follows them, so the two agree in substance.
